## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jun 1, 2026 - Jul 28, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Bethan Hughes_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "I downloaded this app and it was okay. They lure you in with videos of beautiful people doing yoga and I did a few sessions but it didn't work for me. The biggest problem I had with it was the subscription auto renewing without any warning. The first time I contacted the Asana Rebel team, I asked to cancel the subscription and I got a refund relatively promptly. Fast forward a year, more money came out and I still haven't had my money back despite contacting them multiple times."
            2. _Rafał Polito_, Jun 1, 2026, 1/5: "After one year eveb when I cancelled subscription they still planned to grab and stole my money, liars!"
            3. _Angelica Hauca_, Jul 21, 2026, 4/5: "Hi, I've been using the app for a few months. It's helpful if you don't have time and can't get to a gym. The only problem was when renewing the subscription, I didn't receive any notification about it even though I had canceled the subscription in the phone's app store settings. However, it was quickly resolved with the help of the in-app support and I got my money back. Thank you!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
